description: Declared set of Nishfleet repos enrolled in the agent-ready queue (.github/workflows/agent-dispatch.yml); a PR against this file is the enrolment.
preconditions: Every enrolled repo MUST have (a) a git checkout at <checkout_root>/<name>, (b) every `required_labels` name present on the repo, and (c) an .github/workflows/agent-dispatch.yml stub whose on.pull_request_target.types lists all nine events (dequeued, auto_merge_disabled, closed, auto_merge_enabled, synchronize, labeled, opened, reopened, ready_for_review) — hold-risky is the only door into review-risky and a pull_request_target trigger fires only for the types its own repo's stub lists. `agent-dispatch` fires only on the `agent-ready` label.

deferred.name: fleet-ops
deferred.reason: Tripwire tripped. Nish 2026-09-22: 'protect compute. no bs should be built in the first place, rather than being blocked at gates.' Last 24h on fleet-ops: 149 merged PRs vs 45 on 0509; of the 149, 50 are docs/observe-close/reports the fleet writes about itself, 36 are Jev shadow/advisory tiers whose own text says they change nothing, 0 touch the product. 100 open agent-ready issues, all self-filed by the worker bot (worker files findings, intake labels them agent-ready, a worker claims them: a self-feeding loop). Control-plane work now enters ONLY as a packet scoped by Fable or Nish: a repair upstream of a product outcome (dead lane, seat wall, a gate that let a D-grade PR merge). No auto-intake and no scout on this repo. The worker-exit top-up re-runs its sweep (sweep_only above, fleet-ops#10638), which only retries items already labelled agent-ready. Re-enrol via PR when the fleet-ops:0509 merge ratio inverts on product supply, not before.

deferred.name: nish-vault
deferred.reason: fleet-ops#10653: control plane, not product. The vault holds the standing rules, the shared memory and the decisions ledger that every other agent is judged against, so a repo a worker can edit is one that can loosen the gate that judges it. The stub PR (Nishfleet/nish-vault#102) is merged and the six labels and the checkout are in place, so the only missing precondition is AGENT_MODE=live, which the hand-off lane may not set. Its Skills Library checks also failed on runner netcup-vault-1 on 2026-10-28 at the runner-probe step, which reported /run/user/1000/fleet-worker-github-token readable from the job. That runner instance had started before the user manager created the dir, so the unit's InaccessiblePaths entry over it was skipped. The runner restarted at 2026-10-29 04:34:46 IST, the mask now applies (checked in /proc/1726495/mountinfo), and a re-run of the same head reports checked=11 readable=0 in all four jobs. The probe reports the path only and opens no file, so the check printed no token value. Re-enrol by PR: the review path decides (Jev judges, then one Opus final say).
